test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R sits second to the left of N. P is an immediate neighbour of O and R. M sits second to the left of Q. Who sits to the immediate right of P?
solution:
Given: Six people M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R sits second to the left of N.

2) P is an immediate neighbour of O and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6b30128dd6e9b5cb4ba785d55305e79ee952376f4ce6bbb6aacc5e339dedcf9.png] 

3) M sits second to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a7806c134026fcf6e0cff92b1a54ccd3418b38ec5a9248312fdc2fe7944259.png] 

So. 'R' sits to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
